It reads you back before it spends a thing.

This is one actual run of the engine — a Spring Cleanup volunteer flyer — rendered as the chat the user would see. No silent defaults, no blind jump to generate. The three posters at the end are the real images the engine returned.

What "no silent defaults" buys you

The old path could pick an aspect ratio, palette, and model silently and jump straight to generation. Now the engine emits one review: every extracted field tagged said or inferred, every design default shown with its reasoning, and the full plan — for a single human approval. Nothing irreversible (and nothing billable) happens until you tap Generate.

This is a real engine run: live Opus 4.8 extraction + planning, a real review payload, and three real nano-banana-pro images on approve. The phone chrome is a mockup; the conversation, the field tags, the surfaced defaults, and the posters are the engine's actual output. Next: the original flyer storyboard or the newsletter flow.
